title: Prince George TSA Landscape Biodiversity Objectives Implementation Policy, revised December 2005
madeUnder: Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act s. 4(1) (landscape units) and s. 4(2) (objectives); continued as objectives under the Forest and Range Practices Act (its section E applies FRPA s. 16(2)
transcribedFrom: signed PDF, text layer checked against the pages
notes: Prevails over: Replaces the objectives of the Order Establishing Provincial Non-Spatial Old Growth Order (June 30, 2004) for this area (Order III)

Superseded by: None known. Section E: ceases to have effect for any area where a later order of the Minister or designate establishes old forest objectives. The 2022 District Managers' letter of expectations (pgtsa-loe) states the order has never been amended; it changes implementation (spatial COFAs) without amending it.
